name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 installments, direct to bank account
description: Income support for land-holding farmer families. Higher-income exclusions (income-tax payers, institutional landholders, serving govt employees) apply at verification.
apply_mode: Online at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmer's Corner) or via CSC

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (College/University)
benefit: ₹12,000 per year for UG (top scorers in class 12)
description: Scholarship for meritorious 12th-pass students from families with income up to ₹4.5 lakh, pursuing regular UG/PG courses. Requires being in the top 20th percentile of the board exam.
apply_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: Full tuition/compulsory fees + academic allowance
description: For Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation level (class 11 and above), family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
apply_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) / state portal

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
benefit: ₹12,000 per year (classes 9 to 12)
description: For meritorious students of economically weaker sections studying in classes 9–12 in government/aided schools; family income up to ₹3.5 lakh. Selection through a state-level exam in class 8.
apply_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students
benefit: Admission + tuition fee support and maintenance allowance
description: For students from notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) studying class 11 and above; family income up to ₹2 lakh.
apply_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
benefit: ₹1.2 lakh (plains) / ₹1.3 lakh (hilly areas) for house construction
description: Housing assistance for rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha/dilapidated houses. Beneficiary list is based on SECC/Awaas+ survey data.
apply_mode: Through Gram Panchayat / Block office; status on pmayg.nic.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove
description: Free LPG connections for adult women from poor households (BPL/SECC/priority ration-card families).
apply_mode: Online at pmuy.gov.in or at the nearest LPG distributor

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization
description: Cashless health cover for poor and vulnerable families. Final inclusion is per SECC-2011 deprivation criteria / state beneficiary lists — check your name on the official portal.
apply_mode: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in or call 14555

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000/month after age 60
description: Contributory pension scheme for workers, especially in the unorganised sector. Income-tax payers are not eligible to join (post Oct 2022 rule).
apply_mode: Through your bank branch or net-banking

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh accident cover at ₹20/year
description: Accidental death and disability insurance, renewed annually via bank auto-debit.
apply_mode: Through your bank branch or net-banking

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover at ₹436/year
description: One-year renewable term life insurance via bank auto-debit.
apply_mode: Through your bank branch or net-banking

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest, tax-free savings account for a girl child
description: Small-savings account for a girl child below 10, openable at post offices and banks; matures when she turns 21.
apply_mode: At any post office or authorised bank branch

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, skill training with stipend, collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 notified trades: carpenter, blacksmith, tailor, cobbler, potter, etc.).
apply_mode: Online at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or via CSC

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (NSAP)
benefit: ₹200–₹500/month central pension (states usually top up)
description: Old-age pension for persons aged 60+ belonging to BPL households.
apply_mode: Through Gram Panchayat / municipality or state NSAP portal

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (Skill India)
benefit: Free short-term skill training and certification
description: Free NSQF-aligned skill training for youth, with certification and placement assistance.
apply_mode: Register at skillindiadigital.gov.in or a nearby training centre

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NSAP)
benefit: ₹20,000 one-time assistance
description: Lump-sum assistance to a BPL household on the death of its primary breadwinner (aged 18–59).
apply_mode: Through Gram Panchayat / municipality

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana
benefit: Basic savings account with access to banking, RuPay card and eligible overdraft/insurance benefits
description: Financial inclusion scheme for people who do not already have a basic savings bank account. Account opening is available through banks and Business Correspondent outlets.
documents: Aadhaar card or other accepted KYC document
apply_mode: At a bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra) outlet

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free institutional credit for eligible micro enterprises, with loan categories up to ₹20 lakh
description: Credit scheme for non-corporate, non-farm micro enterprises and certain allied-agriculture activities. Lending is through participating banks, NBFCs and MFIs.
apply_mode: Through participating banks, NBFCs or MFIs

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
benefit: Credit-linked subsidy support for setting up eligible new micro enterprises
description: Supports new self-employment ventures and micro enterprises. Individuals must be above 18; additional education and project conditions apply for specified project sizes.
apply_mode: Online through the PMEGP portal and implementing agencies

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
benefit: Working-capital support through successive loan tranches for eligible street vendors
description: Working-capital loan support for eligible street vendors identified through the applicable urban-local-body/vendor verification process, including eligible vendors in surrounding areas covered by the scheme.
documents: Certificate of Vending / ID card or applicable Letter of Recommendation
apply_mode: Through the PM SVANidhi portal/mobile app or participating lending institutions

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyaan (PM-KUSUM)
benefit: Support for solar agricultural pumps and solarisation of eligible agricultural pump systems
description: Supports eligible farmers and other permitted groups under different components for decentralized solar power, standalone solar pumps and solarisation of grid-connected agricultural pumps.
documents: Agriculture/pump or electricity connection documents where applicable
apply_mode: Through the state implementing agency / designated portal

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefit: Central financial assistance for eligible residential rooftop solar systems
description: Supports residential consumers installing rooftop solar systems through the national portal. Eligibility includes Indian citizenship, a suitable roof, a valid residential electricity connection and no previous solar subsidy for the installation.
apply_mode: Apply through the National Portal and the local DISCOM process

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana 2.0
benefit: Maternity cash support for eligible pregnant and lactating women
description: Maternity benefit scheme for women meeting specified social, economic or occupational eligibility conditions. Benefit also covers a second child when the second child is a girl, subject to scheme conditions.
apply_mode: Through the PMMVY portal / Anganwadi or designated implementing channel

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Crop insurance protection against specified crop losses and risks under notified areas/crops
description: Government crop-insurance scheme for farmers for notified crops and areas, subject to applicable season, crop, state and enrolment conditions.
apply_mode: Through the PMFBY portal, participating banks/financial channels or state-notified channels

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan
benefit: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60 for eligible subscribers
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers aged 18–40 with monthly income up to ₹15,000, subject to exclusion conditions.
apply_mode: Through Common Service Centres (CSCs) / Maandhan enrolment channels

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana
benefit: Minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60 for eligible small and marginal farmers
description: Voluntary contributory pension scheme for small and marginal landholding farmers entering between ages 18 and 40, subject to exclusion conditions.
apply_mode: Through CSCs, designated state channels or the PM-KMY portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
benefit: Housing assistance through PMAY-U 2.0 verticals for eligible urban families
description: Housing support for eligible EWS/LIG/MIG families living in urban areas and having no pucca house anywhere in the country, subject to prior housing-benefit and other verification conditions.
apply_mode: Through the PMAY-U 2.0 Unified Web Portal, CSC or concerned ULB

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme 2.0
benefit: Government stipend support for eligible apprentices under the apprenticeship ecosystem
description: Promotes apprenticeship training and provides partial stipend support under NAPS-2. The upper age limit for apprentices seeking partial stipend support is 35 at registration.
apply_mode: Register through the apprenticeship portal and apply to eligible apprenticeship opportunities

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
benefit: Free placement-linked skill training for eligible rural youth
description: Placement-linked skilling programme for rural youth from poor households. Standard age is 15–35, with relaxation up to 45 for women and specified vulnerable groups.
documents: Income/BPL or category proof where applicable
apply_mode: Through state skill missions and approved training partners

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan
benefit: Non-formal vocational skill training for eligible beneficiaries
description: Provides doorstep/non-formal skill training for non-literates, neo-literates, persons with rudimentary education and school dropouts up to Class XII, generally aged 15–45, with priority to women and disadvantaged groups.
apply_mode: Through the local Jan Shikshan Sansthan centre
